scope: Evaluation standard; no new training authorization. Posthoc development on historically examined data, not pristine validation.

activity.source: Simulation truth only, shared across models
activity.window: Trailing five two-second intervals; shorter startup elapsed time
activity.water_fraction_rate: max(water at window start - water at window end,0)/initial water/elapsed seconds
classes: fuel-release active: fuel rate >= active threshold
drying only: water rate >= active threshold and fuel below active threshold
quiet: both rates below quiet threshold
activity.forecast_groups: Active if every predicted step is release-active or drying; quiet if every step quiet; weak if every step weak; transition otherwise. Transition means category change, not necessarily physical ignition/shutdown.
activity.limitations: Engineering tolerances, smoothing lag; not combustion or extinction criterion. Heat cooling alone does not make a window active.

forecasts.origin: All valid observed origins; observed history through origin, self-fed predictions afterward
forecasts.baseline: Hold origin state fixed for entire forecast

aggregation: Mean error over eligible origins per history; average seed replicas within configuration; equal configurations within fold; equal available folds. Report counts and missing groups. Same eligible samples and folds for all compared models.

metrics.error_vs_sim_percent: 100 * aggregate absolute error / aggregate absolute truth; ratio of aggregates, not mean of per-case percentages
metrics.reduction_vs_no_change_percent: 100 * (1 - aggregate model absolute error / aggregate no-change absolute error)
metrics.absolute_errors: Always report water/fuel kg or clearly converted g, gas kg/s or g/s, heating index K. Near-zero denominator is not evidence of large physical error; show denominator and absolute error; zero denominator means undefined.
metrics.event: Full-rollout positive-release total and peak errors, raw fixed-time release error, cumulative release t10/t50/t90 errors, excess after true t99, quiet error share. Separate water/fuel net-loss errors.
metrics.physical_validity: Raw negative fractions/magnitudes and mass increases, without silent clipping
metrics.scenario_distribution: Per-state per-group configuration-level MAE median and90th percentile, fraction configurations beating no-change using paired MAE, ties separately. Not yet computed in current activity report.
metrics.timing_alignment: Best +/-10second shift is optimistic descriptive diagnostic only, never primary forecast score.

selection: Declare training loss, validation checkpoint criterion and stopping rules before run; current reference uses original-three-state full autonomous validation normalized MSE. Freeze all rotation selections before test. Never select thresholds or checkpoints using test performance.
change_control: Do not overwrite v1 or silently change thresholds/groups/denominators. Proposed changes require a new version and side-by-side evaluation; retain v1. Features/architecture/training changes need their own authorized experiment.
current_coverage: 16second activity comparison for3-state MLP,3-state GRU,4-state GRU completed. No4-state MLP trained. Other horizons currently have old broad active masks; not yet recomputed with v1. Event metrics and physical-invalid metrics exist; per-configuration distribution and net-loss summaries still require implementation.
